conceptZh: 豆：豆子；兔子魔術師從帽子變出豆漿卻失手，豆子和豆莢拔河拉出豆字。
object: a cartoon magician rabbit in a top hat, a pod of round soybeans, and a pitcher of soy milk
morph: rabbit and a stubborn bean pod pull opposite ends of a vine until the beans pop into the strokes of 豆
creativeAngle: 兔子魔術師想從帽子裡變出豆漿，卻變出一條豆莢藤；豆子往另一邊跑，兩邊拔河，彈回來剛好排成豆字。
promptEn: An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip on a solid pale cream-pink backdrop. Cast: a cartoon magician rabbit in a tall purple top hat and a star-tipped wand, whose tricks always misfire in a harmless, funnier way, plus a plump green bean pod on a vine with tiny round beans that wiggle. The only text on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 豆, drawn in saturated warm-brown strokes with a soft golden edge, ending centered, uncropped, about 70 percent of frame height with margins. 0.0-1.5s: the rabbit sweeps off his hat with a flourish, taps it with the wand, and pulls out a long green vine instead of the pitcher he was aiming for; he blinks at it. The first narrated 豆 lands as a first fat bean rolls out of the hat and bounces on the floor. 1.5-3.5s: the other end of the vine is wrapped around the pod, which grips the floor; tug-of-war begins, the rabbit leans back with his ears streaming and the pod digs in like a stubborn mule, round beans rattling out one after another, dancing around the rabbit's feet. The second narrated 豆 lands as the vine snaps, the beans fly together, and spring into the strokes of 豆 with a soft bonk. 3.5-5.0s: the rabbit tumbles backward into his own hat with only his feet visible, then pops up with a milk moustache after the pitcher he did mean to conjure finally drops from the sky in a gentle splash. As the word 豆漿 is spoken, the rabbit pours a glass of warm white soy milk into a small cup, steam curling up, and a tiny bean wearing a paper hat waves from the cup's rim. 5.0-8.0s: the glyph is perfectly still and readable for the last 3 seconds while the rabbit, to one side, sips his soy milk with his pinky out, takes a bow, and the bean gives a happy wiggle. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, clear tones, no erhua, reading exactly these syllables: 豆、豆、豆漿 (ㄉㄡˋ、ㄉㄡˋ、ㄉㄡˋ ㄐㄧㄤ). The character twice with a short pause, then the word once, then stop. The word is audio only. No background music, no extra speech, no subtitles or flashing effects; stylized cartoon animals and toys only, no real people.
